book.name: Ɔrɔmutaamba sɛbɛ
book.title: Polŋ nyɛgãaŋ sɛbɛ maŋ hã Ɔrɔmutaamba‑i

content: Jaalupãlle
Mi ka dii i tũɔ‑i Febe‑i na naŋ-na, u ce Diiloŋ-maacemma‑i u kãyã Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba maŋ Sãŋkire‑i-na

Duɔ kã, na ne Itieŋo‑i aa na bel-o fafamma ŋaa maŋ saaya ma ce dumaa Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baaŋ miɛ i hɔlma-na. Kumaŋ maama‑i da ma waa-yuɔ, na kãyã-yuɔ baa ku bĩŋkũŋgu‑i. U kãayã nuɔmba bɔi, halle mɛi fɛrɛ maŋ daami‑i.
Mi jaalaa Pirsika‑i
baa Akilasi‑i, ba yaa mi namaacenciraamba Yesu-Kirsa suoŋgu-na.
Ba hĩɛrã kuliiŋgu‑i da ba gbãa hũu muɔŋo‑i kuɔ. Mi jaal-ba. Aa mɛi da-mi-diei sĩ yoŋ. Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba maŋ *niɛraaŋ-nilɛiŋa-na hiere, ba jaalaa-ba.
Mi jaalaa Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba maŋ tigiiŋ ba cãrã Diiloŋo‑i Akilasi ba dumɛlle-na. Mi jaalaa mi jĩɛŋo‑i Epayinɛti‑i. U yaa hũyãa *Kirsa maama‑i igɛ̃na *Asi‑i-na.
Mi jaalaa Maari‑i, u vaa u fɛrɛ baa na maama‑i.

Mi jaalaa Ãndorkusi‑i baa Yuniya‑i. Bafamba‑i mɛi nelleŋ-tobimba. I waa kaso‑i-na baa i-naa. Yesu *pɔpuɔrbiemba namba'i bafamba‑i, ba kũŋgu dɔlnu nuɔmba‑i. Bafamba daa yuŋ-bĩncɔsĩnni muɔ-na Kirsa horre-na.
Mi jaalaa Ãmpilatusi‑i, u maama dii kpelle mi huɔŋga-na Itieŋo horre-na.
Mi jaalaa Urbɛ̃‑i, u yaa i namaacenceroŋo Kirsa suoŋgu-na. Aa bi jaal Sitakisi‑i; fuɔ maama bi dii kpelle mi huɔŋga-na.
Mi jaalaa Apelɛsi‑i, u pigãaŋ wuɔ u nyaarãa Kirsa‑i-na. Mi jaalaa Aritobul dumɛlleŋ-baamba‑i.
Mi jaalaa mi nelleŋ-tobiŋo‑i Erodiyɔ̃‑i. Aa jaal Narsisi dumɛlleŋ-baamba maŋ hũyãa Itieŋo maama‑i.
Mi jaalaa Tirfɛni‑i baa Tirfosi‑i. Caaŋ daaba‑i ba hãi‑i-na, ba vaa ba fɛrɛ baa Itieŋo maacemma‑i. Aa bi jaal Pɛrside‑i, fuɔ maama bi dii kpelle mi huɔŋga-na, aa u bi vaa u fɛrɛ baa Itieŋo maama‑i.
Mi jaalaa Urufusi‑i, Itieŋo yufelleŋ-nolŋo‑i. Aa bi jaal u nyu‑i, uu dii ŋaa mɛi fɛrɛ‑i mi bi nyu.
Mi bi jaalaa Asɛ̃ŋkiri‑i, baa Filegɔ̃‑i, baa Ɛrmɛsi‑i, baa Paturobasi‑i, baa Ɛrmasi‑i baa tobimba maŋ dii baa-ba hiere.
Mi jaalaa Filologi‑i baa Yulusi‑i, aa jaal Nerieŋo‑i baa tɔ̃nciɛŋo‑i, aa bi jaal Olɛ̃mpasi‑i baa Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba maŋ dii baa-ba hiere.
Taa na jaal na-naa fafamma ŋaa cɛduɔŋ-bieŋ namaa. Bamaŋ dii Kirsa horre-na hiere ba pãa-na jaaluŋgu.

Tobiŋ namaa, jande mi cãrã-nɛi, Diiloŋ-hũmelle maŋ maama‑i waaŋ baa-na, bamaŋ miɛlãa-ma, bilaaŋ na fɛrɛ kutaamba-na; ba jo baa bɔrɔmma, aa ba pira nuɔmba‑i Diiloŋ-hũmelle-na. Baa na ta na piɛ kutaamba‑i.
Ba sa cãa Itieŋo‑i *Kirsa‑i, ŋga ba cãa ba kusũnni. Ba tãal bamaŋ sa suyaaŋ ku yaaŋga‑i baa ba nudɔdɔlle‑i.
Namaaŋo‑i, nuɔmba‑i hiere ba suyaa wuɔ na nu Itieŋo nuŋgu‑i. Terieŋgu faŋgu-na, ku dɔlnu-miɛ baa-na. Ŋga mi taara na ta na suɔ ãnfafamma‑i na ce-ma aa na baa yaŋ ãmbabalma ji kpatalla-nɛi.
Diiloŋo‑i Hɔfɛ̃llentieŋo‑i, a saa baa cɛllɛ, u ka mal *Sitãni‑i hã na ce na bãaŋgu‑i yuɔ. Itieŋo‑i Yesu u kãyã-nɛi.
Mi nabentieŋo‑i Timote jaalaa-na, a naara mi nelleŋ-tobimba‑i Lusiwusi‑i baa Yasɔ̃‑i baa Sosipatɛr hiere.
Muɔ Tɛrtusi, mi bi jaalaa-na. Ii dii baa i-naa Itieŋo horre-na. Muɔmɛi nyɛgãaŋ Pol sɛbɛ daayo‑i hã-yo.
Gawusi bi pãa na jaaluŋgu. Muɔ Pol, mi haraa u yaa nuɔ‑i. Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba‑i hiere ba tigiiŋ fuɔ terieŋ-nu'i ba jaal Diiloŋo‑i. Nelle gbeitieratieŋo‑i Erati jaalaa-na baa i natobiŋo‑i Kartusi‑i. [
Itieŋo‑i Yesu-Kirsa u kãyã-nɛi hiere. Ma ce dumaa.]
Jaaluperieŋgu

Yaaŋ i tiɛ jaal Diiloŋo‑i! Miŋ waŋ *Neldɔdɔlma maŋ baa-na Yesu-Kirsa maama-na, u yaa gbãa ce na yiɛra doŋ u hũmelle-na a saa baa nelma famma‑i. Diiloŋo kusũŋgu maŋ naa fuo dii ku domma-na, ku puuriiye fiɛfiɛ‑i-na Neldɔdɔl daama yaa nuɔ‑i.
Diiloŋo maŋ si dii duɔ ji kã terieŋgu, u ciɛ u *pɔpuɔrbiemba waŋ u kusũŋgu‑i ba sɛbɛbaa-ba-na nuɔmba‑i hiere nilɛiŋa-na ba da ba suɔ-ma aa hũu-ma aa ce-ma.
Diiloŋo yaa u diei yoŋ nelnurãŋo‑i. Yaaŋ i tiɛ jaal-o hɔnniŋ joŋ Yesu-Kirsa barguɔ‑i-na! Ma ciɛ!
